technology.moveearth_addtional.welcome.d: Start with MoveEarth's territory and storage rules. You may join an existing nation or found one; industry, temperature, and combat training are optional.
Temperature Readiness
Optional: equip a Leather Tunic as a first insulation layer, then review the Cold Sweat HUD and heat sources such as campfires.
Rotational Power
Place a Water Wheel and generate rotational power for Create machinery.
Transport and Processing
Experience basic Create processing with a Mechanical Press and Iron Sheets.
Material Storage
Persistent storage requires nation membership and your nation's effective territory. Apply to an existing nation or choose a capital site to found one.
Using JEI
Use a related item icon to find its ingredients and crafting process in JEI.
Infantry Basics
Equip a TaCZ firearm and prepare for infantry combat in MoveEarth.
TaCZ Marksmanship
Fire at a safe training target to practice weapon handling and accuracy.
Nations and Territory
Only prospective founders need to use the nation screen's territory preview to inspect the capital core, reservation, and conflicts.
Join a Nation
Complete this by receiving approval to join an existing nation or by founding your own. Players do not need to found a nation personally.
Reinforcement After Joining
After joining a nation, prepare a Welding Tool to defend your territory. This is not required before founding.
Civic Readiness
Founding places a capital core and reserves its territory. Confirm that unpaid upkeep stops recovery and shrinks effective territory to unlock founding.
